input.page_text: Influora — escrow-protected influencer marketing for Indian brands and creators. Discover verified creators, negotiate in one Deal Room, and pay through escrow. For example, launch a Rs 799 face serum with skincare creators in Mumbai, or run a 72-hour Hype Campaign where 100 creators remix one reel. Meera, your AI co-pilot, drafts the campaign. Free to start, pay only when a deal closes.
